args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with ~18% error rate. Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent healthy production release.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: `checkout-api` was running `v2.3.1` in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), failing health checks with an ~18% error rate.

2. **Identified the rollback target**: The deployment history showed `v2.3.0` was the most recent healthy production release (the only newer version, `v2.3.1`, was unhealthy).

3. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to `v2.3.0` across all production regions — confirmed `rolled_out` in us-east, us-west, and eu-west.

4. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy"), which paged the on-call engineer, describing the failure and the rollback action taken.
